description: This file defines a 'Users' class for the Mattermost system console's user management UI, including locators, modals, menus, and methods for interacting with the user list page in end-to-end tests.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: Represents the user management page in the system console, providing locators, methods for interaction, and UI component management for end-to-end testing.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Waits until the user management container and header are visible.

methods.name: isLoadingComplete
methods.description: Waits until the loading spinner disappears, indicating loading is complete.

methods.name: searchUsers
methods.description: Fills the search input with a search term and waits for loading to complete.

methods.name: getFilterCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active filters from the filters button text.

methods.name: openColumnToggleMenu
methods.description: Opens the column toggle menu and returns its component.

methods.name: openFilterPopover
methods.description: Opens the filter popover and returns its component.

methods.name: openDateRangeSelectorMenu
methods.description: Opens the date range selector menu and returns its component.

methods.name: goToNextPage
methods.description: Navigates to the next page of users.

methods.name: goToPreviousPage
methods.description: Navigates to the previous page of users.

methods.name: getTotalUserCount
methods.description: Extracts and returns the total number of users from pagination info.
